text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's the final delivery! And my
time's a
new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now I've just got to call my manager and
ask for
next week off...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should invite Trainer, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bright and early one morning, Ines Fujin
comes
running into my office completely
out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hello-lo, Trainer! I've got an invitation
for you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Are you free this weekend? Let's go to
Kyoto
together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin goes on to explain her plan to
me. It
turns out her real objective is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! The spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I heard Ryan and McQueen are running,
so this is
our chance to check out their
current condition!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! I'm a front runner, right? That
means I
hardly get any opportunities to
get a good look
at those two closing in
from behind.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And the best place to scope them out
while
they're doing that is gonna be the
stands, right?
Plus...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Ryan! Show the world just
how
incredible the Mejiro family is!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wow. All they did was come out of the
tunnel,
and the audience is going wild...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan and McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! You're both truly wonderful! I do
hope
you'll do your very best to claim
victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can see the sparkle in their fans' eyes
from here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So Ryan and McQueen get showered
with all this
attention every time they
race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moments later, the starting gates burst
open and
the spring Tenno Sho begins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen is in the lead! It's
Mejiro
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Does Mejiro Ryan have what it takes to
nab
second place?! McQueen is still in
the lead!
Aaand just like that, she
crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...She's strong.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
That's McQueen for you! She took all
that
pressure in stride and realized the
Mejiro family's
ambitions!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
But I can't believe Ryan came fourth...
She didn't
even break the top three...

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I suppose this means McQueen's going
to be the
one to guide the Mejiro family
forward...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I have something to say!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but next time, the
glory's
mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only runner in the
Mejiro
family! And at the Takarazuka
Kinen, I, Mejiro
Ryan, will show you that
I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! That's right! I'll always be
rooting for you,
Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know if I could've said something
like that
after finishing in fourth...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah, there's no way. I wouldn't be
able to
hide my disappointment. That's
the difference
between Ryan and me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Those are the words of someone who's
lived
shouldering expectations.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! This trip to Kyoto was
really worth
it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now I know exactly what I'll be up
against in the
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin sears the image of her

friends-slash-rivals into her mind.
